svg.title: Mathlib classes and the main peluang declarations
svg.desc: Dependency graph of the Mathlib class chain from SymmetricCategory through CopyDiscardCategory to MarkovCategory, the hub that PositiveCategory, Stoch and the main peluang declarations build on, with the deterministic wide subcategory and FinStoch done and conditionals, almost-sure equality, conditional independence and conditional_unique_as planned.
